tagline.en_US: An internet radio and media streaming server. It accepts streams from a broadcaster or source client and distributes them to listeners over HTTP. The service is a single container and does not need a separate database.

description.en_US: Icecast is an internet radio and media streaming server. It receives audio and media streams from a broadcaster or source client and distributes them to listeners over HTTP. It provides a lightweight platform for broadcasting live audio feeds and operating online radio stations.
